name: Henry Melson Stommel
summary: Influential physical oceanographer known for theories of ocean circulation, abyssal circulation, and westward intensification.

name: Elizabeth Brown
summary: Henry Stommel's wife, organist, and co-author of Volcano Weather.

summary: Oceanographer and frequent collaborator of Henry Stommel at Yale and WHOI.

name: Jule Charney
summary: Meteorologist and oceanographer who invited Stommel to Princeton.

summary: Oceanographer who collaborated with Stommel on double diffusion and salt fountains.

summary: Physicist and oceanographer who co-founded the GFD seminar with Stommel.

name: Walter Munk
summary: Physical oceanographer and contemporary of Stommel at Scripps.

summary: Oceanographer who co-directed the Mid-Ocean Dynamics Experiment with Stommel.

name: John Knauss

summary: Director at Scripps Institution of Oceanography who offered Stommel a job.
